sourceRule: NativeSelectProps omits the native numeric size prop and replaces it with sm|default (default). Other native select props, including multiple, value/defaultValue, disabled, name and onChange are passed through. NativeSelectOption/OptGroup are option/optgroup. The extra ChevronDown is aria-hidden. className styles the surrounding wrapper, not the select.
keyboardAndFocus: The operating system/browser owns popup, arrow, typeahead, modifier selection and Escape behavior. This contract consumes the actual native change transaction; it does not equate every arrow key with a committed change. Escape may close a native picker, and does not fabricate an extra change/revert event. Disabled controls/options cannot be user-chosen; controlled value remains prop-authoritative.
referenceComposition: Choose an available region.
protocol: SCXML consumes actual source/native transaction observations; callback objects remain original. Sends document observed callbacks, not second DOM dispatches. Parent-controlled props alone synchronize authoritative values. HTML/CSS is a semantic projection; executable behavior uses actual pinned React wrappers.

wrapper.description: Actual div owns className and visual size.

control.description: Actual native select; platform owns popup/multiple selection.

option.description: Actual native option; disabled options remain native.
